### 5/8 | Whitney kicks off B.A.K.E. with B!


We know long days on your feet in the kitchen are tough on the body and can leave you with aches and pains.


We asked Whitney - a movement educator, designer, and director based in LA - to guide us through a few easy movements to do before, during, and after baking.


**B** is how to **Build your base** before you start working. Maybe while the oven is preheating…


Check back every Friday for a new video! Next week is about Alignment when you’re standing and working!


If you want to know more about Whitney’s work and background, check out her website,[whitneyschmanski.com](https://www.whitneyschmanski.com/)

### 5/5 | It’s giveaway time


What better time than Microbakery May to host our first 👏 ever 👏 giveaway 👏


We put together a care package of fun and practical gifts - things you’ll actually use on bake days like Sharpies, burn cream, and of course, flakey salt. You can check out all the prizes[in this post](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DX9pL0lSZ1n/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==) .


To enter:
🥯 Post a Hotplate drop sometime in May
🥯 In the drop description, include[#MicrobakeryM](https://www.instagram.com/explore/tags/microbakerymay/)[ay](https://www.instagram.com/explore/tags/microbakerymay/) That’s it! We’ll pick a winner at random on June 1st and ship you all these goodies 📦


### 5/4 | Kicking off with a poll!


We're kicking off the month by polling our baker community about their favorite things, funniest fails, and proudest bakes!


[Take the poll](https://tally.so/r/VLoMZg)


Results will be shared on our Instagram throughout the month!


### 4/20-28 | Application review and callbacks


The Hotplate team reviews 125+ submissions! There’s a mix of familiar and new faces across a range of product specialties and years of experience. We have the very difficult but exciting task of narrowing down the list to fit into 4 weeks of features.


Oryan has a week of back-to-back calls! She meets 1:1 with bakers to learn more about their background, how they run their businesses, what their goals are, and how they might like to be featured during the month.
